diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project via the Compute Engine XPN association API, which requires compute.googleapis.com (and any other listed services) to be enabled first. It has no depends_on on google_project_service.project_services, so on a fresh apply the API enablement and the association can race and the association can fail intermittently. Every other API-dependent resource in this module (shared_vpc_host, service identities, data sources, compute metadata, default service accounts) carries this depends_on; add it here too.
